edits.text: When identifying which orders are pending, you must call `get_order_details` for every order ID in the list provided by `get_user_details` to verify its status.
edits.reason: This makes the existing rule to check status more concrete by specifying the necessary tool calls for all orders.

edits.text: Before informing the user that an order has been cancelled, you must call `cancel_pending_order`.
edits.reason: The agent skipped the mandatory database change tool call before confirming the result to the user.

edits.text: When confirming details for a modification, only confirm the details you have access to from the tools and the policy; do not let the inability to provide other information prevent you from performing the database change if the user has confirmed the modification details.
edits.reason: This clarifies the rule to perform all possible database changes by defining which details the agent is responsible for confirming.
